description: Check tasks (inline YAML, or a tasks file / playbook) against the INSTALLED module docs: unknown options, missing required ones, bad choices and types (YAML 1.1 aware: unquoted off/yes/0755), suboptions, deprecated options. ansible-doc cannot express cross-option rules (mutually_exclusive, required_if), so the answer says what it could not check; it catches action-plugin modules (copy, template) that ansible-lint's args rule skips.

dir.description: Ansible project directory. Default: ANSIBLE_MCP_DIR, else the server's working directory.

file.description: Tasks file, role tasks file or playbook, relative to dir

line.description: Only the task whose span contains this line

task.description: YAML: one task mapping, or a list of tasks

name: ansible_check_task_args
title: Check task arguments
